questions.q_en: You can very clearly see a double band on your Western blots against the His tag. Could you comment on that?
questions.q_zh: 你們用 His-tag 抗體做的 Western blot 上可以很清楚看到雙帶。可以說明一下嗎？
questions.a_en: First, there is no purification step behind our blots to produce a degradation product. We have one imidazole elution panel and nothing else; every other blot is crude culture supernatant, cell lysate or shell permeate. Second, what we do have is a size shift we cannot explain: the Csn construct runs lower than the SamyQ 2.1 construct though they encode the same mature enzyme. We wrote that on the Engineering page as unexplained, with oligomer formation as an untested hypothesis. And we have no plasmid-free WB800 lane on any blot, which is the control that would settle whether a band is ours.
questions.a_zh: 第一，我們的墨點圖背後沒有純化步驟可以產生降解產物。我們只有一張 imidazole 沖提的圖，其他全部是粗萃培養上清、細胞裂解液或殼側透過液。第二，我們真正有的是一個無法解釋的大小位移：Csn 構築跑得比 SamyQ 2.1 構築低，雖然兩者編碼同一個成熟酵素。我們在 Engineering 頁面上把它寫成「未解釋」，並把寡聚體形成列為未驗證的假說。而且我們沒有任何一張墨點圖有無質體的 WB800 對照道，那正是能定案「某條帶是不是我們的」的那一道。
questions.trap_en: Agreeing that it is a degradation product. A judge who says 'I guess' is guessing, and agreeing with a guess you cannot support is worse than correcting it.
questions.trap_zh: 順著回答「那是降解產物」。說「我猜」的評審就是在猜，順著一個你撐不起來的猜測，比直接更正還糟。
questions.basis: asked verbatim of another team at a 2025 judging session

questions.q_en: Your blot says the band is at seventy-five kilodaltons and your other pages say this protein is thirty-seven. Explain.
questions.q_zh: 你們的墨點圖說帶在 75 kDa，其他頁面說這個蛋白是 37。解釋一下。
kw_zh: 約 70 的二聚體，未驗證
41 是文獻上無標籤的酵素
questions.a_en: Both are on our pages and we have not reconciled them. On the constitutive supernatant blots the band is at about 37 kilodaltons, which is where we predicted the secreted enzyme against a 35 kilodalton monomer, and those agree. On the Level 2 light blots it runs at 63 to 75 and once just under 100. ACC deaminase forms a homodimer at about 70, which is our reading, and our own caption calls it a possibility we plan to test. The 41 kilodalton figure from the literature is the untagged, signal-peptide-free purified enzyme, so it is not directly comparable.
questions.a_zh: 兩個都寫在我們的頁面上，而且我們還沒有把它們對起來。組成型上清的墨點圖上，帶在大約 37 kDa，正是我們對分泌型酵素的預測，對上 35 kDa 的單體是吻合的。Level 2 的光控圖上它跑在 63 到 75，有一次在 100 下面一點。ACC deaminase 會形成大約 70 kDa 的同源二聚體，那是我們的解讀，而我們自己的圖說就說那是一個打算驗證的可能。文獻上的 41 kDa 是無標籤、沒有訊號肽的純化酵素，不能直接比較。
questions.trap_en: Asserting the dimer as fact. No cross-linking, no native gel, no plasmid-free lane; it stays a hypothesis.
questions.trap_zh: 把二聚體當事實講。沒有交聯、沒有原生膠、沒有無質體對照道，它只能是假說。
questions.basis: five molecular weights across the part pages, none reconciled

questions.q_en: How do you know the band on that blot is your protein and not something the host makes?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼知道那張膠上的帶是你們的蛋白，而不是宿主本來就有的東西？
kw_zh: 任何圖都沒有未轉形道
questions.a_en: From the blot alone we cannot. Nine blot figures across six part pages and not one carries an untransformed WB800, empty-vector or dark lane; red light is the only negative control on the light blots. We name that gap in our own summary. Where we did run the untransformed host, on the ELISA, it read 4.562 to 5.452 micrograms per millilitre, the same range as four of our six constructs, so we reported that plate as defeated by its own control.
questions.a_zh: 光看墨點圖沒辦法。六個 part 頁面上的九張圖，沒有一張有未轉形的 WB800、空載體或暗處對照道；在光控的圖上，紅光是唯一的陰性對照。這個缺口是我們自己在 Summary 裡點名的。真正有跑未轉形宿主的是 ELISA，讀到 4.562 到 5.452 微克每毫升，和我們六個構築裡的四個同一個範圍，所以我們把那一盤報告成被自己的對照打敗。
questions.trap_en: Saying the His tag proves specificity. An anti-His antibody can cross-react, which is exactly what the missing lane would test.
questions.trap_zh: 說 His 標籤就證明了專一性。抗 His 抗體可能交叉反應，而那正是少掉的那一道要檢驗的事。
questions.basis: the control question, asked of any blot

questions.q_en: Two of your part pages describe the same two blots and reach opposite conclusions. Which caption do I believe?
questions.q_zh: 你們兩個 part 頁面描述同樣兩張墨點圖，卻得到相反的結論。我該相信哪一段圖說？
questions.a_en: The conservative one. One page says intensities were similar across all lanes and the other says the green lanes looked somewhat stronger; both captions are ours and they disagree, so we take the reading that claims less. On those blots green and red are not distinguishable, the ELISA on the same four samples reads 12.9 against 11.8 micrograms per millilitre, and we have never measured our dark-state background, so we do not claim a fold change for the SamyQ system.
questions.a_zh: 保守的那一段。一頁說各道強度相近，另一頁說綠光那幾道看起來稍強；兩段圖說都是我們寫的，而且互相矛盾，所以我們採主張較小的那個讀法。在那些圖上綠光和紅光分不出來，同樣四個樣品的 ELISA 是 12.9 對 11.8 微克每毫升，而且我們從來沒有量過暗態背景，所以 SamyQ 系統我們不主張任何倍率。
questions.trap_en: Defending the stronger caption because it is the better result. The judge has both tabs open.
questions.trap_zh: 因為結論比較好就替比較強的那段圖說辯護。評審兩個分頁都開著。
questions.basis: two sibling part pages for the same Level 2 construct

questions.q_en: You have one purification panel. What did it actually tell you?
questions.q_zh: 你們只有一張純化的圖。它到底告訴了你們什麼？
kw_zh: 哪些緩衝液回收到蛋白
questions.a_en: Which imidazole buffers recovered protein, and nothing more. The fractions were loaded 25, 10, 150 and 250 millimolar in that order, bands appear in the last three and the strongest is at 250, so there is no quantitative relationship between concentration and yield to read off it. We have no purified yield, no purified gel and no concentration: the purification and dialysis sheet produced no result on our wiki. And the concentration list in that caption is still an unfilled placeholder.
questions.a_zh: 哪些 imidazole 緩衝液回收到蛋白，就這樣。分液的上樣順序是 25、10、150、250 毫莫耳，後三個有帶，最強的是 250，所以從這張圖讀不出濃度和產量之間的定量關係。我們沒有純化後的產量、沒有純化後的膠、也沒有濃度：純化與透析那一張實驗表在我們 wiki 上沒有產出結果。而且那段圖說裡的濃度清單到現在還是沒填的佔位符。
questions.trap_en: Implying you have purified protein in hand. You have one panel and no yield.
questions.trap_zh: 暗示你們手上有純化好的蛋白。你們只有一張圖，沒有產量。
questions.basis: follows any mention of a His tag

questions.q_en: Your colony PCR has an extra bright band at 250 base pairs. What is it?
questions.q_zh: 你們的菌落 PCR 在 250 個鹼基對有一條多出來的亮帶。那是什麼？
kw_zh: 非專一性，我們自己寫了
questions.a_en: Non-specific amplification, and that is written in our own caption rather than waiting to be asked. The 632 base pair band is the junction we were screening; the bright 250 and the faint high-molecular-weight bands come off a colony template, which carries genomic DNA as well as plasmid. It is ordinary for colony PCR and it is exactly why a positive colony still has to be sequence-verified before it goes anywhere.
questions.a_zh: 非專一性擴增，而且這是我們自己在圖說裡寫出來的，不是等人問。632 個鹼基對那條是我們要篩的接點；亮的 250 和微弱的高分子量帶來自菌落模板，裡面除了質體還有基因體 DNA。菌落 PCR 本來就會這樣，這也正是陽性菌落還是要先定序確認才能往下用的原因。
questions.trap_en: Apologising for it. It is the one figure where you called an extra band before anyone asked; say that.
questions.trap_zh: 為它道歉。那是你們唯一一張在被問之前就自己點出多餘帶的圖；要把這件事說出來。
questions.basis: the easiest figure-level question on the collection

questions.q_en: Your fractionation blot has two lanes both labelled S. What is the difference between them?
questions.q_zh: 你們的分層墨點圖上有兩道都標著 S。它們差在哪裡？
questions.a_en: We do not know, and the caption says so. The lanes are P1, P2, S and S; signal appears only in the two supernatant lanes, which is the result, but what distinguishes the duplicates was never written down. The same caption also records that there is no loading control and that the ladders are unlabelled on the original. If those two S lanes are the Csn and SamyQ constructs, that blot would serve two part pages, and I cannot tell you which is which.
questions.a_zh: 我們不知道，圖說上也這樣寫。那四道是 P1、P2、S、S；訊號只出現在兩道上清，那就是結果，但兩道重複之間的差別從來沒有被記下來。同一段圖說也記錄了沒有上樣對照，以及原始底片上的標準品沒有標示。如果那兩道 S 是 Csn 和 SamyQ 的構築，這張圖就能服務兩個 part 頁面，而我沒辦法告訴你哪一道是哪一個。
questions.trap_en: Guessing that one is a replicate. The caption says the distinction is unrecorded; say that instead.
questions.trap_zh: 猜其中一道是重複。圖說寫的是「沒有紀錄」，要照這個說。
questions.basis: four lanes, two of them identically labelled

questions.q_en: On your flagship light blot, what did the red control lane do at eight hours?
questions.q_zh: 在你們招牌的那張光控墨點圖上，紅光對照道在八小時做了什麼？
questions.a_en: It showed its strongest band, the same as the green. That is the honest answer and the caption on that figure does not report it; the sentence is on a different part page, where we write that the original construct gave an unclear result because the red reference also peaked at eight hours, which is why we moved to the codon-optimised one. Spectral leakage is one explanation, our red LEDs emit at 640 nanometres where CcaSR wants about 672 to switch off, and we have not tested either directly.
questions.a_zh: 它也出現最強的帶，和綠光一樣。那是誠實的答案，而那張圖的圖說沒有交代；那句話在另一個 part 頁面上，我們在那裡寫著：原本的構築結果不清楚，因為紅光參考組在八小時也達到最強，這就是我們換成密碼子最佳化版本的原因。光譜外溢是一個解釋，我們的紅光 LED 發射在 640 奈米，而 CcaSR 需要大約 672 才會關閉，兩個解釋我們都沒有直接驗證。
questions.trap_en: Narrating the green lanes, which is what the caption does. The question is about the lane the caption skips.
questions.trap_zh: 照著圖說講綠光那幾道。這題問的是圖說跳過的那一道。
questions.basis: the control the flagship caption goes silent on

questions.q_en: This gel screened ten colonies and your next figure says clone fourteen. Where did clone fourteen come from?
questions.q_zh: 這張膠篩了十個菌落，下一張圖卻說 clone 14。clone 14 是哪裡來的？
kw_en: a window, not the whole plate
questions.a_en: The gel answers it, once you look at it. Its lanes are numbered 9 to 19, so the picture is a window onto a bigger plate rather than the whole screen, and clone 14 sits inside that window. The caption's 'one of ten' is counting lanes on the image, not colonies on the plate. The wording should say which ten and it does not, so I can see why it reads as a contradiction.
questions.a_zh: 看一下那張膠就有答案了。它的道次編號是 9 到 19，所以這張圖是比較大的盤子的局部，而不是整次篩選，clone 14 就落在這個範圍裡。圖說的「10 個中的 1 個」數的是圖片上的道數，不是盤子上的菌落數。文字應該寫清楚是哪十個，而它沒有，所以我明白為什麼讀起來像矛盾。
questions.trap_en: Saying you cannot reconcile it without looking at the gel. The lane numbers are printed on the image.
questions.trap_zh: 沒看膠就說對不起來。道次編號就印在圖片上。
questions.basis: two numbers on adjacent figures of one page
questions.ev_en: BBa_269A97I7 Figure 1: eleven lanes numbered 9 to 19, with the band in lane 14.
questions.ev_zh: BBa_269A97I7 的 Figure 1：十一道，編號 9 到 19，帶在第 14 道。

questions.q_en: Which construct's supernatant actually went on the plants?
questions.q_zh: 真正噴到植物上的是哪一個構築的上清液？
questions.a_en: The Csn ACC deaminase construct. I say that because the figure legend on the plant panel names it, and a legend written at the bench beats an Application sentence written afterwards. The Application paragraph on the Csn page points at the SamyQ page for the same result, which makes a loop, and that sentence is wrong. So we have a plant result for one construct's supernatant, and not a Csn against SamyQ comparison.
questions.a_zh: Csn 的 ACC deaminase 構築。我這樣說，是因為植物那一格的圖說寫的就是它，而在實驗台旁寫下的圖說勝過事後補上的 Application 句子。Csn 頁面上的 Application 段落把同一個結果指向 SamyQ 頁面，造成一個迴圈，而那句話是錯的。所以我們有一個構築上清液的植物結果，但沒有 Csn 對 SamyQ 的比較。
questions.trap_en: Saying 'both'. Only one supernatant was sprayed, and claiming two gives away a comparison you never ran.
questions.trap_zh: 回答「兩個都有」。只噴過一種上清液，講兩個等於送出一個你們從沒做過的比較。
questions.basis: two pages that point at each other

questions.q_en: Your Application section says this part helped plants under salinity. Did you put this part on a plant?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 Application 說這個 part 在鹽逆境下幫助了植物。你們把這個 part 放到植物上了嗎？
kw_zh: 沒有 part 碰過植物
questions.a_en: No. Every trial applied a 0.22 micron filtered culture supernatant from WB800 carrying one of the cassettes, so the evidence reaches the cargo and stops there. We cannot tell you from any plant figure whether a 2.1 coding variant outperforms its wild type, because that comparison was never run on a plant. The sentence should read 'the supernatant from this construct', and where it says 'this part' that is us overreaching.
questions.a_zh: 沒有。每一次試驗施用的都是帶著某個卡匣的 WB800、經 0.22 微米過濾的培養上清，所以證據到 cargo 這一層就停了。任何一張植物圖都無法告訴你某個 2.1 編碼變體是否優於它的野生型，因為那個比較從來沒有在植物上做過。那句話應該寫「這個構築的上清液」，寫成「這個 part」就是我們講過頭了。
questions.trap_en: Defending the sentence. Correcting your own wording in the room costs less than having it corrected for you.
questions.trap_zh: 替那句話辯護。在現場自己更正用字，代價小於被別人更正。
questions.basis: the claim that sits on twenty Application sections

questions.q_en: Your vehicle control suppresses plant growth by a factor of ten. What does that do to your protectant results?
questions.q_zh: 你們的載體對照把植物生長壓了十倍。這對你們的保護蛋白結果有什麼影響？
questions.a_en: It means every protectant result has to be read against a matched vehicle control and not against medium alone, which is what we did. Undiluted TB medium carrying WB800 drops fresh weight from about 0.065 grams to about 0.006, and even one in sixteen stays well below the no-medium group. So the comparison that counts is one-in-forty protectant against one-in-forty WB800, both carrying the same suppressive vehicle. It also means we cannot quote an absolute effect size against an untreated plant.
questions.a_zh: 這表示每一個保護蛋白的結果都必須對照配對的載體對照來讀，而不是對照純培養基，而我們就是這樣做的。未稀釋、帶著 WB800 的 TB 培養液把鮮重從大約 0.065 公克壓到大約 0.006，就算稀釋到十六分之一，還是遠低於完全沒有培養液的組。所以真正算數的比較是 1/40 的保護蛋白對 1/40 的 WB800，兩邊帶著同樣會抑制生長的載體。這也表示我們沒辦法引用一個相對於未處理植物的絕對效果量。
questions.trap_en: Treating the vehicle figure as a problem to explain away. It is the control that makes the rest readable.
questions.trap_zh: 把載體那張圖當成要辯解掉的問題。它正是讓其他結果可讀的那個對照。
questions.basis: a figure the team published themselves, and should lead with

questions.q_en: Your heat-stressed untreated plate is marked contaminated on the figure itself. What is the claim then?
questions.q_zh: 你們熱逆境的未處理對照盤，在圖上就被標記為污染。那你們的主張是什麼？
questions.a_en: The claim is weaker than the panel looks, and our own caption says so. Three of the eight plates are marked contaminated, including the untreated heat-stressed control, which is the one the treatment would have to beat. The significance brackets run from the unstressed control to everything else, so they do not compare a treated group with its own stressed control. No panel there shows a statistically tested advantage of ACC deaminase. We left both facts on the public page rather than cropping them out.
questions.a_zh: 主張比那張圖看起來弱，而我們自己的圖說就這樣寫。八個盤裡有三個被標記污染，包括未處理的熱逆境對照，而那正是處理組必須勝過的對象。顯著性的括號是從無逆境對照連到其他所有組，所以它們並沒有拿處理組和它自己的逆境對照相比。那裡沒有任何一格顯示 ACC deaminase 有經統計檢定的優勢。我們把這兩件事都留在公開頁面上，沒有裁掉。
questions.trap_en: Reading the panel as a positive result. The honest version is stronger here than the optimistic one.
questions.trap_zh: 把那張圖讀成正面結果。在這裡誠實的版本比樂觀的版本更有力。
questions.basis: the team's own legend writes the judge's question for them

questions.q_en: Your BoPep4 helped plants at one dilution out of four. Is that a result?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 BoPep4 在四個稀釋倍數裡只有一個對植物有幫助。那算結果嗎？
kw_en: one dilution, one run, no repeat
questions.a_en: It is an observation, not a result. One in forty improved fresh weight and chlorophyll per plant against both controls in one unreplicated hydroponic run, and one in sixty, eighty and a hundred gave nothing. On the third panel, relative chlorophyll, the medium-only control is actually the highest salt-stressed group, above one in forty. So the honest sentence is that a filtered supernatant improved two of three readouts at a single dilution in one run, and we say that rather than calling it salinity rescue.
questions.a_zh: 那是一個觀察，不是一個結果。在一次沒有重複的水耕試驗裡，1/40 在鮮重和每株葉綠素上都勝過兩個對照，而 1/60、1/80、1/100 完全沒有效果。在第三格的相對葉綠素上，純培養基對照其實是鹽逆境組裡最高的，高過 1/40。所以誠實的說法是：一次試驗、單一稀釋倍數下，過濾上清改善了三個指標裡的兩個；我們這樣說，而不是說它拯救了鹽逆境。
questions.trap_en: Quoting the strongest panel and skipping the third. The judge has the figure open.
questions.trap_zh: 只引用最強的那一格、跳過第三格。評審圖就開著。
questions.basis: dose-response with one responder and no repeat

questions.q_en: Only six of your forty-one parts have a characterisation section. Why so few?
questions.q_zh: 你們四十一個 parts 裡只有六個有 characterisation 區段。為什麼這麼少？
kw_zh: 只有 ACC deaminase 被量過
questions.a_en: Because characterisation means measured behaviour and we only have it for ACC deaminase. All six are ACCD. BoPep4 is twenty-three residues and does not resolve on a standard blot, which is why ELISA is its detection method, and we never ran a blot for LEA14 at all. Writing a characterisation section for the other thirty-five would mean writing up something we did not measure, and I would rather have an empty slot than that.
questions.a_zh: 因為 characterisation 指的是量到的行為，而我們只有 ACC deaminase 有。六個全部是 ACCD。BoPep4 只有二十三個胺基酸，標準墨點圖解析不出來，所以它的偵測方法是 ELISA；LEA14 我們則完全沒有跑過墨點圖。替其他三十五個寫 characterisation，就等於寫我們沒有量過的東西，我寧可留白。
questions.trap_en: Promising they are coming. Say what exists, say why the rest does not, and stop.
questions.trap_zh: 承諾之後會補。講清楚現在有什麼、其他為什麼沒有，然後停住。
questions.basis: a coverage gap visible from the collection index

questions.q_en: Your DNPH assay shows a fourteen-fold light response at thirteen hours and the opposite at sixteen. What happened?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 DNPH 在十三小時顯示十四倍的光反應，十六小時卻反過來。發生了什麼事？
questions.a_en: We do not know, and the shape of the data says we should not read much into either point. Thirteen hours gives green over red fourteen to one, the cleanest light response this assay has produced. Sixteen hours inverts it. Neither point is repeated, the error bar on the thirteen hour green point runs from about five to sixteen on the activity scale, and across both times colour comes out at p equals 0.72. The experiment that would settle it is one culture, one maturation time, both colours, repeated, and it is not in our record.
questions.a_zh: 我們不知道，而且數據的形狀告訴我們兩個點都不該讀太多。十三小時綠光以十四比一勝過紅光，是這個檢測給過我們最乾淨的光反應。十六小時反轉。兩個點都沒有重複，十三小時綠光那一點的誤差棒在活性尺度上從大約五延伸到十六，而兩個時間合起來看，顏色的 p 值是 0.72。能定案的實驗是同一批培養、固定一個成熟時間、兩種顏色、做重複，而我們的紀錄裡沒有。
questions.trap_en: Leading with the fourteen-fold number. It is the one a judge will ask you to defend.
questions.trap_zh: 用十四倍這個數字開場。那正是評審會要你辯護的那一個。
questions.basis: a single-well result with a reversal three hours later

questions.q_en: What is the single piece of evidence on your Registry you would stake the project on?
questions.q_zh: 你們 Registry 上，哪一個證據是你敢拿整個專題去賭的？
kw_zh: 72 小時維持 2 µg/mL 以上
questions.a_en: The permeate. ACC deaminase in shell permeate above two micrograms per millilitre through a seventy-two hour run, and catalytically active from eighteen hours, with specific activity reaching 6.3 units per milligram and holding between five and eight through to seventy-two. It is the one place where protein identity, protein quantity and enzyme function are measured on the same material coming out of the rig, and the lag between the protein appearing and the activity appearing is itself informative.
questions.a_zh: 透過液。殼側透過液裡的 ACC deaminase 在七十二小時的運轉中維持在兩微克每毫升以上，而且從十八小時起具有催化活性，比活性達到 6.3 單位每毫克，一路到七十二小時維持在五到八之間。那是唯一一個地方：蛋白的身分、蛋白的量和酵素的功能，量的是同一份從機器裡出來的材料；而且蛋白先出現、活性後出現的那個時間差本身就有意義。
questions.trap_en: Reaching for the ELISA construct panel or a DNPH plate. Those did not clear their controls.
questions.trap_zh: 去拿 ELISA 的構築面板或某一盤 DNPH。那些沒有通過自己的對照。
